title: TravelItem
description: Canonical contract between capture, extraction, resolution and commit stages. Field ownership is declared with x-owner: extractor | resolver | committer | ingest. A stage MUST NOT write fields it does not own.

booking_group_id.description: Ties segments originating from one booking document. All legs of a PNR share this.

canonical_key.description: Dedup primitive. See A5. Unique index in DB. Null until resolution.

segment_index.description: Position within the batch. Stable across reprocessing.

ref.description: Gmail message id, GCal event id, sha256 of URL, or upload filename.

document_timestamp.description: Date header of the email / page capture time. Used to order competing versions of the same canonical_key. Newer wins.

rule_id.description: source_rules row that admitted this item.

Artifact.description: Immutable original. Never mutated. Enables reprocessing and fixture promotion.

path.description: Content-addressed path, relative to artifact root.

children.description: Attachments extracted from the parent (e.g. .ics inside an .eml).

model.description: e.g. qwen2.5:14b-instruct. Null for deterministic extractors.

Payload.description: THE LLM-CONSTRAINED OBJECT. This subtree, and only this subtree, is what an extractor emits.

booking_status.description: A cancellation email is NOT a new item. It is this field set to cancelled on an existing canonical_key.

capture_required_fields.description: Fields the extractor could NOT obtain from the document and which the capture client must supply. Non-empty + unsatisfied => needs_review.

DateTimeLocal.description: Never a bare ISO string. AirTrail rejects the whole batch when a midnight default collides; forcing precision to be explicit makes that failure impossible to produce accidentally.

local.description: Wall-clock time at the place. No offset. Date-only permitted when precision=date.

precision.description: date => time was genuinely absent from the source. NEVER synthesise 00:00 to satisfy a target.

tz.description: IANA, single slash only. Two-slash zones (America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires) must be mapped to backward aliases before this field is set. Extractor sets if stated; resolver fills from place lookup.

utc.description: Computed from local+tz. Null while tz unknown or precision != datetime.

origin.description: Where the date came from. capture_context = the human typed it. NEVER 'inferred' for a stored commit.

is_home.description: Matched a HomeProfile in force at the time of travel.

suppressed.description: True => no AdventureLog Location is written. The place data is STILL retained in the payload; suppression is a write decision, not deletion.

raw_name.description: Verbatim, e.g. MEHTA/DANIELMR. Never normalised in place.

role.description: Resolver assigns via alias table. Extractor MUST leave null.

match_source.description: inferred_absent = no passenger list in source; self assumed per policy. Audit trail for the notify-on-inference rule.

FlightDetail.description: ONE SEGMENT. A multi-leg PNR fans out to N TravelItems sharing booking_group_id.

flight_number.description: Digits only. Carrier lives in marketing_carrier.

terminal.description: Full value. AirTrail adapter clamps to 10 chars; schema does not.

waypoints.description: Intermediate stops, in travel order. Each MAY become its own Location; home-radius waypoints are suppressed like any other.

round_trip.description: Origin and destination are the same place (typical home-out-and-back drive).

collection_action.description: Only a FLIGHT may yield 'created', and only when no existing collection matches. 'user_selected' = supplied via capture_context; the ladder is skipped by design. Everything else attaches or defers.

candidate_collections.description: Populated when >1 match. Drives the review UI choice list.

self_on_booking.description: False => AirTrail commit is skipped entirely (guest-only rule).

duplicate_of.description: TravelItem id this superseded or was superseded by.

targets.description: What SHOULD be written. Computed here, executed by commit.

anchor_eligible.description: Item may mint a collection. TRUE ONLY FOR FLIGHTS that leave the home radius. Ground transport is never anchor-eligible regardless of distance.

within_home_radius.description: Entire item never left home radius => outcome should be ignored.

match_attempted.description: Resolver ran the full match ladder before minting. 'created' without this is an unproven claim that nothing matched.

adventurelog.description: Per-record results. Replaces the old fixed object.

target_versions.description: Version probe result at commit time. Guards against silent schema drift.

StatusBlock.description: Four INDEPENDENT states. A single status column cannot express 'extracted fine, AirTrail ok, AdventureLog failed'.

adventurelog.description: Per-type rollup, derived from commit.adventurelog. Worst state wins within a type.

escalation.description: Cloud escalation is user-initiated only. Redaction is mandatory and audited.

IngestBatch.description: A single push. One artifact (email / SingleFile capture / .ics) fans out to N TravelItems. This is the unit the /ingest endpoint accepts and the unit the extractor emits.

declared_segment_count.description: What the source claimed it contained, if stated. Mismatch vs len(items) is RULE-16 — a silently dropped leg is the worst failure mode here because nothing errors.

batch_status.description: partial = some items committed, some did not. Never roll up to complete.

PayloadBatch.description: THE LLM-CONSTRAINED ROOT. One document may contain many segments; the extractor MUST return an array even for a single item.

UpdateAction.description: Explicit decision point. create = no prior item for this canonical_key. update = prior exists, newer document, fields changed. no_change = prior exists, content_hash identical (the common case for check-in reminders and boarding passes). supersede = prior exists and this cancels/replaces it. conflict = prior exists, this document is OLDER or contradicts a user-edited field -> always needs_review, never auto-applied. ignore = matched a suppression rule.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the normalised payload. Equality => no_change.

changed_fields.description: JSON pointers into payload. Drives the review-UI diff view.

field_locks.description: JSON pointers a human edited in the review UI. An incoming update MUST NOT overwrite these; it becomes conflict instead. RULE-15.

stale.description: document_timestamp older than prior. Out-of-order delivery.

AdventureLogResult.description: One row per WRITTEN RECORD, not per type. A single flight yields two location rows (departure + arrival airport), which a per-type status cannot represent.

key.description: Stable discriminator within type, e.g. location:YYZ, location:LHR.

depends_on.description: Keys that must reach ok first. transportation/lodging/note always depend on collection.

HomeProfile.description: Config, not per-item. Effective-dated because home changes and historical backfill must be judged against the home in force AT THE TIME of travel.

radius_km.description: Anything wholly inside this radius is not a trip. Primary guard against road-trip noise: a 12km drive to dinner must never mint a collection.

suppress_location.description: Never create an AdventureLog Location for this place.

can_anchor_collection.description: Departing from / returning to here is what makes a round trip legible. Suppressed as a Location, still usable as a trip anchor.

RouteDetail.description: Planning-time estimate from a directions provider. NOT actuals — Dawarich owns the raw GPS timeline. This is the intended route only.

CaptureContext.description: Metadata supplied BY THE HUMAN at submission time, not derived from the document. Required for sources that carry no date — a Google Maps directions URL has an origin, waypoints and destination and nothing else. The capture client must collect this before POSTing.

travel_date.description: Date of travel. Mandatory for maps captures.

travel_time.description: Optional. Absent => DateTimeLocal.precision=date, never defaulted to 00:00.

collection_id.description: User-selected AdventureLog collection. When present the resolver SKIPS the match ladder — the human already decided. This is the normal path for road trips: collection created in advance to book time off, drive plan attached later.

traveler_refs.description: Alias ids chosen from a picker. Drives have no passenger manifest.
